description: In the sophisticated Bastille neighbourhood, this spacious four-bedroom duplex apartment will be your key to Paris. This neighbourhood in the 11th arrondissement is famous for its magnificent architecture, cultural institutions, and shopping. The use of bold colours gives each room a modern and distinct personality. The inviting living room will make you feel at home, and the lovely dining area is ideal for creating memorable experiences with family and friends.The space140sqm1st bedroom (1 queen bed)Ensuite bathroom (shower only)2nd bedroom (1 queen bed)Ensuite bathroom (shower only)3rd bedroom (1queen bed)4th bedroom (2 single beds)3rd bathroom (shower/toilet)2 extra separated toiletsLuxury bathroom essentialsPlush linens and towelsFully equipped modern kitchenNespresso machine with capsulesNote: Two of the four bedrooms of the duplex are only accessible by stairs. Mind that the privilege to experience such an exclusive location, only a few steps from the Place De La Bastille, might come with some noisy moments.Special Note: Please note that the building elevator is not fully in service.Other things to noteTo ensure a smooth and secure arrival, you will need to complete a brief online check-in process before your stay. It's quick, easy, and helps us prepare for your visit!
